description: Checked pointwise-to-natural reconstruction connection, conditional on its explicit presentation and adjunction data
limits: The explicit hypotheses include a supplied adjunction, chosen copowers and cokernels, a presentation isomorphism and a unit formula. This connection does not construct those inputs or prove the full projective-generator equivalence from source hypotheses. It does not discharge the original project choice-free endpoint.
